prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On August 16 at Mazda Stadium, Hanshin turned an early lead into a complete win. The Tigers beat Hiroshima 8-1, but the story was not only the final score. It was how quickly Hanshin took control and how little room Hiroshima found to answer.

The opening came in the first inning. Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field, putting Hanshin ahead before the game could settle.

Ryohto Ihara then supported that lead with a steady start. The Hanshin pitcher worked five innings, allowing only two hits and one run. He gave Hiroshima little chance to build pressure.

Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth inning. Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run, giving the home team a brief reply. But that was all Hiroshima could produce.

Hanshin added more runs in the seventh and eighth innings. The lead grew instead of shrinking, and the game moved firmly toward the Tigers. The final result was Hiroshima 1, Hanshin 8.

【Point One】
Hiroshima did get on the board, but Montero’s fifth-inning solo shot stood alone as the team’s only score. With Ihara allowing just two hits in five innings, that reply did not put Hanshin’s early lead under lasting pressure. It was a brief answer, not a change in control.

【Point Two】
Hanshin’s attack did not depend on Sato’s home run alone. In the seventh, Seishiro Sakamoto and pinch-hitter Taira Fushimi each drove in a run. In the eighth, Sakamoto added a double that brought in another run. The later scoring came from different places in the lineup.
